module_summary: Iterative radix-2 restoring divider: an 8-step counter shifts a remainder/quotient register SR through a subtract-and-select datapath, with sign fixup and valid/ready handshake.

anchors.name: SR
anchors.why: Combined remainder/quotient shift register updated each iteration

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Iteration counter; bit 3 ends division and sets res_valid

anchors.name: start_cnt
anchors.why: Busy flag: set on accepted request, gates iterative SR updates

anchors.name: res_valid
anchors.why: Result valid; set at completion, cleared on res_ready, blocks new requests

anchors.name: opn_valid
anchors.why: Operation request; starts division and captures operands when idle

anchors.name: res_ready
anchors.why: Consumer accept; with res_valid clears result valid

anchors.name: result
anchors.why: Sign-corrected remainder and quotient concatenated output

anchors.name: NEG_DIVISOR
anchors.why: Negated absolute divisor captured at start, added to partial remainder

anchors.name: mux_result
anchors.why: Restoring select: difference or unchanged remainder written back into SR

anchors.name: CO
anchors.why: Subtraction carry-out; selects restore path and becomes quotient bit

anchors.name: sub_result
anchors.why: Partial remainder plus negated divisor trial subtraction

anchors.name: dividend_save
anchors.why: Captured dividend; sign bit drives remainder/quotient sign correction

anchors.name: divisor_save
anchors.why: Captured divisor; sign bit drives quotient sign correction

anchors.name: divident_abs
anchors.why: Absolute dividend loaded into SR at operation start

anchors.name: data_go
anchors.why: Handshake completion res_valid & res_ready, clears res_valid

groups.name: control
groups.description: Busy flag and iteration counter sequencing start, 8 steps, and finish

groups.name: divide_datapath
groups.description: Shift register SR with trial subtract and restoring mux

groups.name: sign_fixup
groups.description: Saved operand signs negate remainder and quotient for signed result

groups.name: handshake
groups.description: Request valid input and result valid/ready output handshake
